label: ERP dashboard

label: Analytics dashboard
desc: Warm white and orange analytics page with KPI cards, area chart, traffic-source donut and top pages, driven by a date-range switch.

label: Finance dashboard
desc: Balance card, income vs expense bars, category-filtered transactions, budget progress and a debit card widget with reveal and freeze.

label: Art marketplace page

label: Restaurant landing page

use: restaurant, cafe or venue landing page

label: Wind 404 page
